newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sea-Com ask-only after TSE withdrawal announcement.
newsitem.headline: Sea-Com ask-only after TSE withdrawal announcement.

text.p: Shares in Sea-Com Corp were ask-only in Tokyo morning trading on Friday, following its announcement that it will withdraw its shares from the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE), brokers said.
As of 0059 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 19 yen, compared with their Thursday close of 25.

On Thursday, Sea-Com, which operates shipping and hotel businesses, announced that it would withdraw its shares from the TSE after failing to win support for a new restructuring plan from its main creditor. It said its debt would exceed assets by 46 billion yen at the end of March.
Its financing division and overseas division had been hit hard by the bursting of Japan's economic "bubble" of inflated asset prices in the late 1980s, it said.

The TSE announced on Friday that it had put the Sea-Com shares in a special category to let investors know they are about to be delisted. But it did not say when the shares will be delisted from the TSE's second section.
